metadata.description: Claude Code extensions: ECC workflow helpers, session chatlogs and a wall board of all sessions

plugins.name: ecc-progress
plugins.description: Side pane showing ECC PRD milestones and /prp-implement task progress

plugins.name: ecc-doc-check
plugins.description: Read-only consistency audit across ECC PRDs, PRP-PRDs and PRP plans

plugins.name: chatlog
plugins.description: Real-time session chatlog (Markdown + text + JSONL) with interrupts, exits, /clear and resume, plus terminal-style replay

plugins.name: session-board
plugins.description: Reports each session's state, last prompt, last answer and ECC progress to a wall board served by a zero-dependency Python server
